after.zh: 原图减去模糊图，剩下的正是细节（高频）。把细节加回去，图就变“锐”了。
after.en: The original minus the blurred image leaves exactly the detail (the high frequencies). Add the detail back and the image becomes "sharper".

t.zh: 暗房时代的摄影师有个怪招：把一张故意洗模糊的底片和原底片叠在一起印，照片反而更清楚。修图软件里的「USM 锐化」（unsharp mask）就源自这个做法。
t.en: Darkroom photographers had an odd trick: print the original negative stacked with a deliberately blurred copy, and the photo comes out clearer. The "USM sharpening" (unsharp mask) in photo editors comes from this technique.

t.zh: <part-ref to="gauss"></part-ref>是你在<level-ref to="1-4"></level-ref>里得到的元件，σ 控制模糊得多宽。
t.en: <part-ref to="gauss"></part-ref> is the part you earned in <level-ref to="1-4"></level-ref>. σ controls how wide the blur is.

t.zh: 要想的问题：「原图 − 模糊图」这张差图里，留下的是什么？为什么把它加回原图，图就显得更锐利？
t.en: Something to think about: what is left in the difference image "original − blurred"? Why does adding it back to the original make the image look sharper?

t.zh: 这一关你要做的：按公式搭出锐化。用地形画法看期望，每道台阶的边上都多出了一道凸起和一道凹陷。
t.en: Your task in this level: build the sharpening from the formula. In terrain view, the expected output has an extra ridge and an extra dip beside every step.

caption.zh: 第一组测试：方块，用地形画法看

brief.zh: 让细节更清楚：输出 = 原图 + 1.5 ×（原图 − 模糊图）。模糊用 σ = 1 的高斯。
brief.en: Make the details clearer: output = original + 1.5 × (original − blurred). Blur with a Gaussian of σ = 1.
